## HUNTER v0.1 — WATCH ONLY

Searches public crypto opportunity feeds hourly.

- Airdrops / giveaways / launchpools / learn-to-earn / quests / testnets
- Deduplicates for 30 days
- Alerts only score ≥80
- Max 5 alerts per run
- Scam phrases heavily penalized
- No wallet access
- No signing
- No trading
- No transfers

Telegram alert is informational only.
